neighbours.label: a noun used as the first half of a hyphenated compound (father-absent, state-backed, drug-induced)
fire: Children raised in father-absent homes often struggle at school.
The rebels were supported by a state-backed militia.
She was treated for a drug-induced liver injury.
The club runs several student-led workshops each term.
Investors fled the oil-dependent economy after the crash.
The firm adopted a customer-centric strategy last year.
Doctors described the case as a stress-related illness.
Migrants settled in the mineral-rich northern provinces.
quiet: Children raised by their father often struggle at school.
The rebels were supported by the state and its militia.
She was treated for a liver injury caused by drugs.
The club runs several workshops for students each term.
Investors fled the economy after the oil crash.
The firm adopted a new strategy for customers last year.
Doctors described the case as an illness caused by stress.
Migrants settled in the northern provinces rich in minerals.
